description: Read the page as an accessibility outline (headings, text, links, buttons, fields). Elements you can act on carry a ref like e123 for browser_click and browser_type; plain elements the page made clickable show as "clickable". Refs stop working after the page changes, so take a new snapshot then.

tabId.description: Tab id from browser_open_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: browser_snapshot
